court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Calaveras
case_search_note: No online case search found on the court's site (Online Services lists court calendars, tentative rulings, traffic payments and eFiling). Use Court Calendars (https://www.calaveras.courts.ca.gov/online-services/court-calendars) or call the clerk.

courthouses.name: Calaveras Superior Court (San Andreas)
courthouses.hours: Courthouse Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; clerk window 8:15 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; clerk phones 8:15 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Only courthouse in the county; hears criminal and traffic. Self-Help Legal Center (209) 754-1443. Unpaid fines may be referred to collections (LGBS 1-844-544-5354 or FTB-COD 1-800-272-9829).

public_defenders.name: Calaveras County Public Defender
public_defenders.note: Mailing: PO Box 725, San Andreas, CA 95249. Fax (209) 754-4143.
public_defenders.todo: Hours not listed on county page

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Auburn Office
legal_aid.serves: Low-income residents of Amador, Calaveras, El Dorado, Nevada, Placer and Sierra counties
legal_aid.what: Free CIVIL legal help — housing and public benefits (CalWORKs, CalFresh, Medi-Cal, General Assistance, SSI/Social Security, unemployment, SDI). Not criminal defense; page does not mention record clearing.
legal_aid.hours: Intake Mon–Thu 9 a.m.–12 p.m. and 1:15–4 p.m.; no new intakes Fridays

probation.name: Calaveras County Probation Department
probation.note: Mailing: 891 Mountain Ranch Road, San Andreas, CA 95249. Fax (209) 754-4913. Fines/fees/restitution can be paid online (GovPay).

programs.name: Pretrial Release Risk Assessment (SB 36)
programs.summary: Calaveras Probation publishes its SB 36 pretrial release risk-assessment tools policy. The page does not describe check-in rules — follow your release order and ask Probation.
programs.todo: Collaborative courts: the Judicial Council 2026 fact sheet lists Calaveras but which court types was not readable; no court page found

jails.name: Calaveras County Adult Detention Facility
jails.phone_note: Jail office Mon–Fri 8 a.m.–4 p.m. (closed weekends/holidays). Fax (209) 754-6716. Sheriff main (209) 754-6500.
jails.note: Visits scheduled through Securus (except non-contact glass visits); Sunday visits/new visitor registration due by 2 p.m. the Friday before. Money: SmartDeposit online, Securus, or lobby kiosk during business hours (need arrest number). Also houses Alpine County inmates under contract (per Alpine Sheriff). court_ids: nearest criminal courthouse, not confirmed.
jails.todo: Men/women housing not stated on Sheriff pages

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' (linked from insurance.ca.gov CheckAgntBrkr page) — look up any bail agent's license status. Calaveras Sheriff pages give no bail procedure; call the jail at (209) 754-6499. Daily booking logs: https://sheriff.calaverasgov.us/Press-Releases-Logs
